arguments.name: input-limit
arguments.description: Sets a maximum limit for the values that can be input into. Input values are clipped between zero and this value. The default value, when no argument is present, is 128. By supplying an argument, you can change the maximum input value up to a maximum of 16384.

messages.name: clear
messages.description: Erases the memory of theobject entirely, but retains the most recently received number to use as the next "previous" value.

messages.name: int
messages.description: Reports how many times this number and the previously received number have occurred in immediate succession. (The first time a number is received, there has been no previous number, so nothing happens.)

messages.name: reset
messages.description: Erases the most recently received number from the memory of theobject. The next number to be received gets stored in its place, to serve as the next "previous" value (but nothing else happens).
